f.title: Apply the AGEMED GPvP certification audit directive
f.statement: The Audit Directive for Certification in Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPFV) must be used on a mandatory basis by regulated laboratories, importers and distributors of medicines recognised by law (and by AGEMED staff).

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: Directriz que deberá ser utilizada de manera obligatoria por los regulados Laboratorios, lmportadoras y Distribuidoras de Medicamentos Reconocidos por Ley y el personal de Ia AGEMED.
rows.review_note: Review: quote is in the recitals of the resolution, not the operative articles; level Mandatory kept because the directive is approved by Art. 1 and the recital states mandatory use. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: recital source lowers confidence slightly.
rows.quote_en: A Directive that shall be used on a mandatory basis by the regulated Laboratories, Importers and Distributors of Medicines Recognised by Law and by AGEMED staff.

f.title: Comply with and enforce the BPFV certification directive
f.statement: Applicant companies (and AGEMED staff) are responsible for complying with, and enforcing, what this directive provides.
f.applicability: Industrial pharmaceutical laboratories, importers, national distributors and pharmacovigilance centres of public and private health establishments

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: Es responsabilidad tanto de las empresas solicitantes como del personal profesional, técnico y administrativo de AGEMED cumplir y hacer cumplir lo dispuesto en este documento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: It is the responsibility of both the applicant companies and the professional, technical and administrative staff of AGEMED to comply with and enforce the provisions of this document.

f.title: Submit the BPFV audit application with signed letter and fee payments
f.statement: The application for a Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPFV) certification audit requires: a request letter signed by the pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company or health establishment, addressed to the AGEMED Executive General Directorate; a copy of the payment order and invoice for the BPFV audit service; and a copy of the payment order and invoice for the BPFV certificate.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: Carta de solicitud firmada por el/la Responsable de Farmacovigilancia de Ia Empresa/Establecimiento de Salud, dirigida a Ia DirecciOn General Ejecutiva de Ia AGEMED. • Copia de Ia Orden de Pago y Factura por el servicio de Auditorla BPFV. • Copia de Ia Orden de Pago y Factura por el Certificado BPFV.
rows.review_note: Review: requirement list has no modal verb; listed as requirements (requisitos) so Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: level inferred from heading.
rows.quote_en: Request letter signed by the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person of the Company/Health Establishment, addressed to the Executive General Directorate of AGEMED. • Copy of the Payment Order and Invoice for the BPFV Audit service. • Copy of the Payment Order and Invoice for the BPFV Certificate.

f.title: Request the BPFV audit by 31 January of the certificate expiry year
f.statement: The pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company or health establishment must send AGEMED the BPFV audit request, addressed to the Executive General Directorate, by 31 January of the year in which the certificate expires, or of the year of a new application.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company or health establishment
rows.deadline: By 31 January of the year the certificate expires (or of a new application)
rows.quote: El/Ia Responsable de Farmacovigilancia de Ia Empresa/Establecimiento de Salud, deberá remitir a Ia AGEMED Ia solicitud de auditorla en BPFV dirigida a Ia DirecciOn General Ejecutiva de Ia Agenda Estatal de Medicamentos y TecnologIas en Salud — AGEMED hasta el 31 de enero del año de vencimiento del certificado o nueva solicitud.
rows.review_note: Review: recurring annual cut-off, not a fixed calendar date, so no deadline_rule. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: deberá = Mandatory.
rows.quote_en: The Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person of the Company/Health Establishment shall send AGEMED the BPFV audit request addressed to the Executive General Directorate of the State Agency for Medicines and Health Technologies (AGEMED) by 31 January of the year in which the certificate expires or of the new application.

f.title: Send the PSMF, confidentiality undertaking and fee proof 5 business days before the audit
f.statement: At least 5 business days before the audit, the pharmacovigilance responsible person must send AGEMED the Pharmacovigilance Master File, the confidentiality undertaking signed by the pharmacovigilance responsible person and the legal representative (or the director of the health establishment), and a copy of the payment order and invoice according to the current tariff.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company or health establishment
rows.quote: El/la Responsable de Farmacovigilancia de Ia empresa/Establecimiento de Salud deberá remitir a Ia AGEMED el Archivo Maestro de Farmacovigilancia, el Compromiso de Confidencialidad firmado por el Responsable de Farmacovigilancia y Representante Legal o Director del Establecimiento de Salud, adjuntando Ia copia de Ia orden de pago y factura de acuerdo al arancel vigente, con 5 dIas hábiles de anticipación al proceso de auditorla.
rows.review_note: Review: deadline counts backwards from the audit; clock_start quotes the audit event. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: deberá = Mandatory; backward-counted rule noted.
rows.quote_en: The Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person of the company/Health Establishment shall send AGEMED the Pharmacovigilance Master File, the Confidentiality Undertaking signed by the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person and the Legal Representative or Director of the Health Establishment, attaching a copy of the payment order and invoice according to the current tariff, 5 business days before the audit process.

deadline_rule.applies_to: PSMF, confidentiality undertaking and audit fee proof (counted back from the audit date)

f.title: Attend the BPFV audit opening meeting with designated staff
f.statement: At the opening meeting of the audit, the company or health establishment must be represented by its pharmacovigilance responsible person and other designated staff; the audit plan read by the lead auditor is signed in two copies, one for the company representative.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company or health establishment
rows.quote: Por parte de Ia empresa/Establecimiento de Salud, estarán presentes el Responsable de Farmacovigilancia y otro personal designado. El Auditor Lider Ieerá el Plan de Auditorla y una vez aprobado, se imprimirán y firmarán dos copias del mismo: una para el representante de Ia Empresa/Establecimiento de Salud designado y otra para el equipo auditor de Ia AGEMED.
rows.review_note: Review: future tense (estarán) read as a procedural requirement = Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: modal force inferred from the procedural future tense.
rows.quote_en: On behalf of the company/Health Establishment, the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person and other designated staff shall be present. The Lead Auditor will read the Audit Plan and, once approved, two copies of it will be printed and signed: one for the designated representative of the Company/Health Establishment and another for the AGEMED audit team.

f.title: Make the PV centre, documents, staff and processes available during the audit
f.statement: During the audit, the AGEMED audit team, together with the designated staff of the company or health establishment, verifies the pharmacovigilance centre, reviews documentation, interviews staff and verifies processes to assess compliance with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices; the company must support this with its designated staff.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: El equipo auditor, junto con eI personal designado de Ia Empresa/Establecimiento de Salud, IIevará a cabo Ia verificación del Centro de Farmacovigilancia y Ia revisiOn de Ia documentaciOn. También realizará entrevistas al personal y verificará los procesos, con el objetivo de evaluar el cumplimiento de los requisitos establecidos en las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia (BPFV).
rows.review_note: Review: duty is chiefly on the audit team; company participation through designated staff is stated. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: company duty is implied, so kept below 90.
rows.quote_en: The audit team, together with the designated staff of the Company/Health Establishment, will carry out the verification of the Pharmacovigilance Centre and the review of the documentation. It will also interview staff and verify processes, in order to assess compliance with the requirements established in Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPFV).

f.title: Sign the audit report and nonconformity forms at the closing meeting
f.statement: Audit records follow the official format only and must carry the signature of all parties concerned. At the closing meeting the audit record-report (Form 052) is read, any nonconformities (Form 053) are presented with deadlines set under current rules, and the documents are signed to confirm agreement with the process.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: las actas segUn formato serán las ünicas y deberán contar con Ia firma de todas las partes interesadas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote taken from the recitals; step 9 confirms signature at the closing meeting. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement adds step 9 context not in the quote, so 86.
rows.quote_en: the records according to the format shall be the only ones and shall bear the signature of all interested parties.

f.title: Submit nonconformity corrective-action evidence by the deadline set
f.statement: When the deadline set for remedying the nonconformities has passed, the pharmacovigilance responsible person must submit the completed nonconformity report forms (Form 053), together with the nonconformity close-out report and the supporting documents that show the measures taken, as AGEMED provides.
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person of the company or health establishment
rows.deadline: Within the period set at the closing meeting
rows.quote: Cumplido el plaza establecido para Ia presentaciOn de las subsanaciones, el Responsable de Farmacovigilancia de Ia Empresa/Establecimiento de Salud remitirá los formularios de Reporte de No Conformidades (Form. 053) debidamente completados, además deberá incluir el informe de levantamiento de No Conformidades y los documentos de respaldos necesarios, conforme a las disposiciones emitidas por Ia AGEMED, que permitan evidenciar las medidas adoptadas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Once the period established for submitting the remediations has elapsed, the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person of the Company/Health Establishment will submit the duly completed Nonconformity Report forms (Form 053), and shall also include the nonconformity close-out report and the necessary supporting documents, in accordance with the provisions issued by AGEMED, that make it possible to evidence the measures adopted.

f.title: Pay the BPFV certificate fee and file a note with the payment proof
f.statement: To obtain the BPFV certificate the corresponding fee under the current tariff must be paid, and the pharmacovigilance responsible person files a note attaching a copy of the payment order and invoice for the certificate.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)

El/Ia Responsable de Farmacovigilancia de Ia Empresa/Establecimiento de Salud ingresará una nota adjuntando Ia copia de Ia Orden de Pago y Factura por el Certificado en BPFV segün arancel vigente.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To obtain the Certificate of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPFV), the corresponding payment shall be made according to the current tariff. 16. The Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person of the Company/Health Establishment will file a note attaching a copy of the Payment Order and Invoice for the BPFV Certificate according to the current tariff.

f.title: Plan for a three-year BPFV certificate validity
f.statement: The Good Pharmacovigilance Practices certificate is valid for three (3) years from its date of issue (three calendar years under Article 2 of the resolution); renewal must be planned accordingly.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: El Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia tendrá una vigencia de tres (3) años a partir de Ia fecha de su emisiOn.
rows.review_note: Review: validity rule; renewal planning is the company consequence. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: "renewal must be planned" is an inference, 88.
rows.quote_en: The Certificate of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices shall be valid for three (3) years from the date of its issue.

f.title: Keep the PV responsible accredited, the PV centre operating and BPFV met to keep the certificate
f.statement: The BPFV certificate is invalidated if an inspection shows that the company has not accredited its pharmacovigilance responsible person, that its pharmacovigilance centre is not functioning, or that it no longer complies with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices.

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: El Certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia quedará invalidado si durante un proceso de inspecciOn se evidencie que: 1. La Empresa no acredite a Ia Responsable de Farmacovigilancia. 2. El Centro de Farmacovigilancia no se encuentre funcionando. 3. Deja de cumplir con las BPFV.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The Certificate of Good Pharmacovigilance Practices shall be invalidated if, during an inspection process, it is shown that: 1. The Company does not accredit the Pharmacovigilance Responsible Person. 2. The Pharmacovigilance Centre is not functioning. 3. It ceases to comply with the BPFV.

f.title: Do not transfer the BPFV certificate
f.statement: The Good Pharmacovigilance Practices certificate is non-transferable.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: El certificado de Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia es intransferible.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The Good Pharmacovigilance Practices certificate is non-transferable.

f.title: Accept post-certification BPFV inspections
f.statement: Companies and health establishments are subject to inspections after certification to confirm compliance with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: Las Empresas/Establecimientos de Salud estarán sujetas a inspecciones posterior a Ia certificaciOn para corroborar el cumplimiento a las Buenas Prácticas de Farmacovigilancia (BPFV).
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Companies/Health Establishments shall be subject to inspections after certification to verify compliance with Good Pharmacovigilance Practices (BPFV).

f.title: Return an invalidated BPFV certificate to AGEMED
f.statement: Where the certificate is invalidated (PV responsible person not accredited, PV centre not functioning, or BPFV no longer met during an inspection), the company must return the BPFV certificate to AGEMED for invalidation.
f.processes: Audit & inspection readiness; Quality system & CAPA

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical company (industrial pharmaceutical laboratory, importer or national distributor of medicines)
rows.quote: Para Ia conform idad de estos Ia empresa debe devolver el certificado de BPFV a Ia AGEMED para su correspondiente invalidaciOn.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: For the conformity of these, the company must return the BPFV certificate to AGEMED for its corresponding invalidation.

f.title: Keep the audit PSMF concise, accurate and within 10 pages
f.statement: The Pharmacovigilance Master File is a detailed description that gives an exact overview of how the pharmacovigilance centre works and complies with current rules. The master file of the company or health establishment to be audited must be concise, contain at least the content listed in Annex I and not exceed 10 pages (letter size).
f.clause: Annex I, Form 051 Archivo Maestro de Farmacovigilancia

f.title: Include company, PV responsible, organisation and database details in the PSMF
f.statement: The audit PSMF must contain at least: (A) brief company/establishment information: business name, exact address, type of activity, telephone numbers and contact person, e-mail and fax, and opening hours; (B) for the pharmacovigilance responsible person: contact details of the responsible person and of the deputy where applicable, and a summary CV with evidence of pharmacovigilance training as an annex; (C) a description of the organisational structure; (D) a description of the location, functionality and operational responsibility of the database.

dates.title: AGEMED BPFV certification audit directive (RA 43/2024): applies
dates.scope: Industrial pharmaceutical laboratories, importers, national distributors and PV centres of health establishments seeking or holding BPFV certification
dates.quote: será aplicable a partir del 2 de enero de 2025
dates.timing_note: The resolution itself enters into force on the business day after its publication on the AGEMED website (date not stated); the directive applies from 2 January 2025.
